[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Distinct subsequences** [LC 115 · Distinct Subsequences](https://leetcode.com/problems/distinct-subsequences/){difficulty="Hard"}

The first-occurrence greedy finds one embedding and stops. On `babgbag` / `bag` it reports 1, and there are 5. The last letter of `s` is either unused, which keeps the same target, or it matches the last letter of `t`, which shortens both. Those two families are disjoint and cover every embedding.

[Solved in full in @sec-st-p3-dist.]{.card-link}
